identity_chain: CtrlS's 29 May 2024 release says the company 'now operates 3 facilities in Hyderabad - one in HITEC City and two in the Gachibowli financial district', after launching Hyderabad DC3 'located in the financial district of Gachibowli'.
CtrlS's 20 January 2025 release repeats that it operates three Hyderabad facilities, one in HITEC City and two in Financial District, Gachibowli.

The operator's about-us timeline lists the 2008 launch of its first Rated-4 facility in Hyderabad (PTDC) and the 2020 launch of Hyderabad DC2; PTDC appears from its name and the Pioneer Towers registered office in Madhapur to be the HITEC City facility (an inference).

The operator's Hyderabad page lists Hyderabad DC 1, DC 2 and DC 3 and links one map location, which resolves to the named place 'CtrlS data center' in the Gachibowli/Nanakramguda Financial District area, not to HITEC City or the Madhapur office address; the marked facility is therefore one of the two Financial District facilities (DC3 and, by the inference above, DC2). The link follows the page's DC3 tour and DC3 resilience sections, but the page does not say which facility it marks.
precision: Operator-linked named facility marker for a CtrlS datacenter in Hyderabad's Financial District (Gachibowli/Nanakramguda), one of CtrlS's two facilities there (DC2 and DC3).
